description: The plot illustrates the performance of different model variants in terms of precision, recall, and F1-score. The x-axis, labeled "Model Variants", is categorical and lists five model configurations: "Model (Ours)", "w/o Prompt", "w/o Augmentation", "w/o Attention", and "w/o Prompt & Augmentation". The y-axis, labeled "Metric (%)", is linear, ranges from 58 to 66, and has tick labels at intervals of 2. The plot displays three lines: precision (purple, solid line, circle markers), recall (blue, solid line, circle markers), and F1-score (brown, solid line, circle markers). The precision line starts at 65.49, decreases to 61.06 at "w/o Prompt", increases to 64.06 at "w/o Augmentation", and then further increases to 66.06 at "w/o Prompt & Augmentation". The recall line begins at 65.78, drops to 59.64 at "w/o Prompt", rises to 62.63 at "w/o Augmentation", and then declines to 56.82 at "w/o Prompt & Augmentation". The F1-score line starts at 65.43, decreases to 60.16 at "w/o Prompt", increases to 63.17 at "w/o Augmentation", and then decreases to 57.74 at "w/o Prompt & Augmentation".
